This same contribution appears in the filing's own bundled original (p7) dated 10/29/15.

expenditures.note: Amount printed '3000.-' - trailing dash means no cents, recorded as 3000.00 per the currency contract. A repayment to the candidate himself; the recipient name is the filer's own name as written. This row REPLACES the original filing's Schedule B row (LOVE COMMUNICATIONS / ADVERTIZING, same date, same 3,000) - the two are the same dollars reported as different transactions, and both are retained, each in its own record.

_meta.notes: BUNDLED DOCUMENT - AGENT_BRIEF s1(4) APPLIES, AND IN A FORM THE BRIEF DOES NOT LIST. This 8-page PDF is TWO documents: pages 1-4 are the AMENDMENT (cover ticks 'Yes, this is an amendment', date of report 1-31-16, RECEIVED MAR 15 2016, filled out in blue ink in a cursive hand) and pages 5-8 are a PHOTOCOPY OF THE ORIGINAL YEAR-END BEING AMENDED (cover ticks no amendment box at all, signature dated 1-31-16, RECEIVED FEB 01 2016, black block capitals) - page for page the same document as this chunk's separate filing 10db75c4, including the struck-through occupation cell and the identical Schedule B row. ONLY PAGES 1-4 ARE TRANSCRIBED HERE. Pages 5-8 are ledgered as a bundled duplicate and none of their figures were summed, or copied, into this record; 10db75c4 holds them. PAIRED FILING - READ WITH 10db75c4. WHAT THE AMENDMENT ACTUALLY CHANGED (the totals are identical, so the change is entirely in the detail): (a) Schedule A's contribution date moves from 10/29/15 in the original to 10/26/15 here; (b) Schedule A's Occupation/Employer is written cleanly as 'SL Co. Mayor' instead of the original's struck-through 'SELF EMPLOYED' overwritten with 'MAYOR - SL COUNTY'; (c) Schedule B's recipient and purpose change entirely, from 'LOVE COMMUNICATIONS / ADVERTIZING' in the original to 'Jim Bradley / Loan Repayment' here - the same 3,000 dollars, reported as a different transaction. (d) The original leaves three of its four schedule footer cells blank; the amendment fills all four. CHUNK-FILE AGREEMENT: unlike its original, THIS form does state the seat - Office 'SL County Council At-Large C', Office Sought 'County Council', District Number 'At-Large C' - which matches the chunk file's seat 'At-Large C'. Party is written out as 'Democrat'. CHUNK-FILE FLAG VERIFIED: the signature Date line is indeed left BLANK on this cover (the only date on it is the amendment-of date 1-31-16 and the clerk's MAR 15 2016 received stamp), so cover.report_date is '' rather than a guess; index.csv's 2016-03-15 is the clerk's received date, not a form date. THE DAY DIGIT ON SCHEDULE A - HOW IT WAS SETTLED: the p3 contribution date's day read ambiguously between 25 and 26 at 200 and 900 dpi. It was resolved WITHIN THIS DOCUMENT, not from any sibling: the same blue-pen hand wrote '1-31-16' on the cover, and that 6 is a distinctive cursive form - a stroke rising to the upper right that curls over and closes into a bottom-left loop - which the disputed glyph matches, while the writer's 5 (in '/15' on the same date cell) is a different two-stroke form with a flat top bar. Date recorded as 2015-10-26 at medium cell confidence. PRIVACY - REAL EXPOSURE ON THIS FILING, AND THE CHUNK FILE HAS IT ON THE WRONG DOCUMENT: the chunk file attaches the flag 'UNREDACTED contributor address cell on Schedule A' to 10db75c4, whose address cell in fact holds only a workplace descriptor for the county government complex. It is THIS filing, 4478799f, whose Schedule A prints a genuine unredacted residential STREET ADDRESS for the contributor - house number and street name in the clear, no black bar - despite the file being named '_redacted'. Per PRIVACY.md that street was discarded at read time: it is written nowhere in this record, not in donor_raw and not in any note, and because no city or state is printed anywhere in the cell there is no geography to keep, so donor_city and donor_state are honestly blank. The candidate's own street-address block and the phone/fax/email block on the cover ARE redacted at source by solid bars. Amounts are written with a trailing dash after whole dollars ('3000.-'); per the currency contract that means no cents, so the row amounts are recorded as 3000.00 and the printed form is named in each row note; the Summary-Page figures are kept verbatim as printed. Column B is blank on every Summary line - totals_to_date are '' (filer left blank), never 0. The Summary Page, Schedule A and Schedule B header boxes (Page _ of _, Last Name, Date of Report) are ALL BLANK. CROSS-DOCUMENT OBSERVATION (recorded, not used to set any value): this chunk's McAdams year-end 9e3ec673 records the mirror side of the contribution on its own expenditure attachment, dated 10/29/2015 - the date the ORIGINAL used, not the 10/26/15 this amendment substituted.

contributions.detail: The single Schedule A row (p3) is 3000.- = printed SUBTOTAL FOR THIS PAGE 3000.- = printed TOTAL CONTRIBUTIONS RECEIVED 3000.- = Summary Page line 1 Column A '3,000' and line 4 '3000.-'. All four printed figures agree. No in-kind marker on the page, so schedule and Summary share one scope. ONLY pages 1-4 were summed; the bundled photocopy on pages 5-8 is a DIFFERENT filing and its identical 3,000 was deliberately NOT added.

expenditures.detail: The single Schedule B row (p4) is 3000.- = printed SUBTOTAL FOR THIS PAGE 3000.- = printed TOTAL EXPENDITUTRES MADE 3000.- = Summary Page line 2 Column A '3,000' and line 6 '3000.-'. Pages 5-8 excluded for the same reason.

itemized.page_subtotal_gates: BOTH gates fire and BOTH pass on this filing (unlike its own original, where three of the four footer cells are blank): p3 row 3000.00 = printed subtotal 3000.- = printed total 3000.-; p4 row 3000.00 = printed subtotal 3000.- = printed total 3000.-. Footer cells confirmed at 900 dpi.
itemized.escalation_note: 900 dpi cell crops on the amendment's own pages: p3 date cell, p3 Occupation+Amount group, p3 SUBTOTAL+TOTAL footer cells, p4 full row band, p4 SUBTOTAL+TOTAL footer cells. Then 1800 dpi crops of the p3 date and the p4 date, a 1200 dpi crop of the cover's handwritten amendment date '1-31-16', and a contrast-stretched magnification of the single disputed p3 day glyph - four escalations spent on one digit (see notes).
